ui.quickIntro: The plain version — everything on one page.
welcome: You are a visitor inside my memory palace.
Type commands, or tap the buttons below.
New here? Type  help.  In a hurry? Type  quick.
help: look              describe the room you're in
go <direction>    move: north, south, east, west (or just n/s/e/w)
examine <thing>   look closely at something (shortcut: x)
ask <question>    talk to my digital self, e.g.  ask what are you best at?
quick             everything on one plain page
clear · replay    clear screen · replay the intro
TIPS  Tab autocompletes · ↑/↓ browse history · click anywhere to skip typing
ui.goWhere: Go where? Try a direction like north or n.
ui.unknown: I don't understand "{input}". Type help for commands.
ui.unknownAsk: Want to ask my digital self instead? Try: {ask} <your question>
ui.askUsage: Ask me anything, e.g.  {ask} what projects are you proudest of?
ui.askOffline: The mirror is quiet for now — the ask feature isn't switched on yet. Try contact instead.
ui.askLimited: Too many questions in a short time. Take a breath and try again in a minute.
ui.askError: The connection to my digital self flickered. Please try again.
